basics.name: Izaac Zavaleta
basics.label: Staff QA Engineer
basics.summary: Staff QA Engineer with a decade-plus of hands-on ownership of quality for Kubernetes and Rancher-based enterprise platforms. Designs end-to-end automation architectures (Playwright, Cypress, Node.js, Python) that hold up across multi-version release trains, builds CI/CD quality gates that catch regressions before they ship, and drives performance and systems-level validation from HTTP layer down to OS syscalls. Comfortable leading test strategy, framework design, and release regression for distributed, multi-tier applications on Linux.

work.name: SUSE
work.summary: Technical lead for quality on Rancher and Kubernetes-facing web solutions, owning test architecture, automation strategy, and release regression across the full release lifecycle.
highlights: Own the end-to-end automation architecture for Rancher web solutions, covering functional, UI, and regression layers across multi-version release trains.
Design and sustain CI/CD quality gates so regression suites run continuously per release cycle instead of as a manual pre-release phase.
Lead framework stabilization work, reducing flaky coverage and keeping suites maintainable as product surface area grows.
Drive quality strategy with product and engineering stakeholders, defining what ships and what blocks, backed by automation evidence.
Pair targeted manual and exploratory testing with automation for iterative releases to maximise web quality of products and solutions.

work.name: SUSE

Sustained and stabilised test frameworks through product changes, writing reusable page and service abstractions.
Applied automation best practices and tooling evaluation to raise coverage, speed, and reliability of the suite.

Sustained and stabilised web test frameworks against a rapidly changing product.
Supplemented automation with manual QA on iterative releases to maximise delivery quality.
